carla_scene_synthetic — DRIVE carla op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.carla_scene_synthetic(lead_distance_m: 'float' = 20.0, *, width: 'int' = 320, height: 'int' = 180, fov_deg: 'float' = 90.0, cam_height: 'float' = 1.6, lateral: 'float' = 0.0, lead_asset: 'str' = 'sedan', asset_root=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import carlabridge; carlabridge.carla_scene_synthetic(lead_distance_m: 'float' = 20.0, *, width: 'int' = 320, height: 'int' = 180, fov_deg: 'float' = 90.0, cam_height: 'float' = 1.6, lateral: 'float' = 0.0, lead_asset: 'str' = 'sedan', asset_root=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("carla_scene_synthetic"))

Usage

Turns our own world (straight road + lead vehicle) into a scene record in CARLA conventions (same keys and types as a captured recording).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

自車のカメラは (x = 20, y = 0, z = cam_height) で +x を向き、先行車(lead_asset)の後ろ面がカメラから lead_distance_m 先(横に lateral m、Fullseye の +y = 左)に来る。lead_distance_m <= 0 は先行車なし。返り値には depth [m] と label(Fullseye のラベル像)と pose(render3d の world → camera)も入れる(記録の鍵ではないが門で使う)。
